chain.why: A private‑hospital stay typically costs about ₹24,000 out of pocket, showing that treatment expenses can be large.
About 1 in 9 Indian adults has diabetes and more than 1 in 3 has high blood pressure, indicating that health issues can develop even when currently healthy.
A fresh policy starts its waiting periods from zero, meaning earlier coverage does not reduce future waiting periods.

conclusion: High out‑of‑pocket treatment costs, the prevalence of diabetes and high blood pressure, and the fact that a fresh policy starts waiting periods from zero together show that relying on savings and current health may leave you unprotected.
